accessFixture.description: Fixture file name (without .json) for an access-rules document. Required for checkAccess.

args.description: Positional arguments to pass to the method.

ctxId.description: Context ID for ctx-family methods (ctxProcess, ctxValidate, ctxAggregate, ctxScan, ctxDocumentAudit). Names the Context fixture of the same name in fixtures/v1, which pins the scheme, crosswalks, guides and access policy the server composes.

ctxVersion.description: Explicit context version for ctx-family methods; omit or leave blank for server default (latest). Pass a semver string or 'latest'.

expect.description: Partial expected result. The runner performs a deep subset-match: every key present in expect must match the actual result.

fixture.description: Fixture file name (without .json) to load as the scheme, or an array for fromLayers. For ctx-family methods, the Context's primary scheme.

guideFixture.description: Fixture file name (without .json) for a guide document. Required for evaluateGuide, evaluateMany and guideScan methods.

method.description: Engine method to invoke. normalize/render/diff wrap their return value as {result}. aggregateAssertions takes a single arg: an array of assertion arrays (each inner array is one marking's already-parsed assertions). evaluateMany takes a single arg: an array of {guideId, ruleId} selections, each naming the guide that holds the rule. evaluateGuide/evaluateMany/guideScan require guideFixture. checkAccess requires accessFixture. registry* methods register the fixture engine in a SchemeRegistry. ctx* methods use ctxId and ctxVersion to target a server-side context, and scheme to select one of its schemes. ctxAggregate takes a single arg: an array of marking strings.

mode.description: How to construct the SchemeEngine: fromJSON (single fixture) or fromLayers (array of fixtures).

name.description: Human-readable identifier for this test case.

refusedWith.description: HTTP status the server refuses the call with, for a ctx-family case that exists to be refused. The runner asserts the call fails with this status and returns no result. A case carries either expect or refusedWith.

scheme.description: Scheme selector for ctx-family methods: the Context-local key of the scheme the operation answers in, sent as ?scheme=. Omitted, the Context's primary scheme answers.

description: Schema for a conformance plan file: a sliced collection of test cases for a single engine capability.

cases.description: Ordered list of test cases exercising this capability.

slice.description: Determines which conformance pipeline processes this plan. 'engine' plans are run per-PR by every language SDK replayer using recorded responses. 'server' plans require a live REST API server and are run only in the nightly cross-SDK Docker workflow.

title: ConformancePlanFile
